mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 50% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of triggered instances despite the recession signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply chain signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises and RSAFS falls simultaneously
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 50% of triggered instances despite the consumer spending shift signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 50% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% for three consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or neutral in > 60% of triggered instances despite the easing signal.
